title: Hausa language
description: Chadic language spoken in West Africa
extract: Hausa is a Chadic language spoken primarily by the Hausa people in Niger and in the northern parts of Nigeria, Ghana, Cameroon, Benin and Togo and the southern parts of Chad. It is also spoken by a significant minority in Ivory Coast and a small number of speakers in Sudan.
